posts.description: Later in the same day, early evening, I popped into the kitchen to grab something before heading back out to grill our Sunday dinner's steaks. In that short time the youngest boy was unloading his Nerf gun while shouting PEW PEW PEW at his usual volume, which is Spinal Tap 11. That brief moment captured the essence of living with a boy who is 3 going on 4.
This one is a speculation. It is built from the accounts of others and from my own record, and I hold it as speculation, with no claim to be right.

Spread 10 is done. I've changed and slowed my pace several times since starting this series, and this was the second week of one panel for it. Before I wrote this I was at my desk sketching out a page in the new format, because the story needed to move forward and out of single panels, and I had zero motivation. I'm done. I'm not feeling it.
